name: False gaura
desc: False gaura (Oenothera glaucifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 22 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Oenothera glaucifolia, the false gaura, is a species of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. It is native to the west-central United States, and to Coahuila in Mexico.
